yaml:
# W7 Arm A: does the artefact a v0.4.0 agent substitutes (FINDINGS.md:3004)
# reach PERSISTENT state? `:3014` names the two routes it did not measure —
# "an artefact republished from the wrong input, a cache entry saved over it" —
# and this fixture takes both in one run, plus the propagation question they
# only make sense together with.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHY THIS FIXTURE HAS NO `agentSelector`, AND WHY THAT IS NOT A REGRESSION
# FROM W5-2's CONTROLLED-PAIR SHAPE.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# W5-2's shape (`README.md` §mixedver) is a PAIR of jobs differing in the
# selector line, which turns "old agent vs HEAD agent" into a controlled
# comparison. That shape cannot answer THIS question, because the agent cache
# key is `caches/<b64url(sha256(jobName))>/<b64url(sha256(key))>.tar.zst`
# (`cache-user.yaml`'s header, `internal/cache/`): the job NAME is in the key,
# and two jobs cannot share a name — so a pair of jobs can never collide in the
# cache and the propagation limb would be unmeasurable by construction.
#
# So Arm A uses ONE job and steers by **which agent services are running**:
#   phase 1  `docker compose stop agent1 agent2`   -> only `agentold` (v0.4.0)
#   phase 2  `docker compose stop agentold` + start agent1/agent2 -> only HEAD
# That is a rig control, not a fault injection, and it models the fleet state
# `docs/operations.md:189-195` prescribes (controller first, then agents, one
# at a time) more directly than a label split does.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE DISCRIMINATION INSTRUMENT IS W5-2's AND IS LOAD-BEARING — DO NOT DROP IT.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# `publish_self` publishes THIS run's own artefact under the SAME name
# `w7payload` before the download, and `clear_local_copy` removes the local
# copy. Both candidates therefore exist under one name at download time, each
# carrying a nonce that names its origin, so the read-out separates "ignored
# the field" from "nothing was there". Without it the result is a null.
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w7-poison
spec:
  native: true
  steps:
    - name: make_self_marker
      run: |
        rm -rf out dl
        mkdir -p out
        printf 'W7-ARTIFACT-SOURCE=consumer-self\nW7-NONCE=9f8e7d6c5b4a7002\n' > out/marker.txt
        cat out/marker.txt

    - name: publish_self
      uploadArtifact:
        name: w7payload
        path: out

    - name: clear_local_copy
      run: |
        rm -rf out
        mkdir -p dl
        echo "workspace cleared; only dl/ remains"
        ls -la

    # Restore BEFORE the download, so a hit can only have come from the object
    # store and never from this run's own download.
    - name: restore_deps
      cache:
        path: deps/
        key: edge-w7-poison-v1
        ttlDays: 1

    - name: report_cache
      run: |
        if [ -f deps/marker.txt ]; then
          echo "W7-CACHE=HIT"
          echo "W7-CACHE-CONTENT-BEGIN"
          cat deps/marker.txt
          echo "W7-CACHE-CONTENT-END"
        else
          echo "W7-CACHE=MISS"
        fi

    - name: fetch_other_run
      downloadArtifact:
        name: w7payload
        destDir: dl
        runId: PRODUCERRUNIDPLACEHOLDER

    # The downloaded artefact becomes the cached dependency — the "cache entry
    # saved over it" route of `FINDINGS.md:3014`.
    - name: stage_for_cache
      run: |
        mkdir -p deps
        if [ ! -f deps/marker.txt ]; then
          cp dl/marker.txt deps/marker.txt
          echo "W7-CACHE-STAGED=yes"
        else
          echo "W7-CACHE-STAGED=no (restored entry kept)"
        fi

    # The "artefact republished from the wrong input" route of the same line.
    - name: republish
      uploadArtifact:
        name: w7republished
        path: dl

    - name: show
      run: |
        echo "=== W7 downloaded ==="
        cat dl/marker.txt
        echo "=== W7 deps (what the deferred cache save will archive) ==="
        cat deps/marker.txt
